subject: Batch J (PR #456) needs three things from the Mac: port PostureAllow.swift against native/shared/posture-allow-vectors.json, build SignalGridMobile after it lands, fix validate-sim-macos.sh --sim-only
body: Same lane order as remediation-allow. (1) SWIFT TWIN: the simulator engine grants its base-trust allow on the PRESENCE of a posture signal and reads attributes only for bad literals, so compliance unknown/expired/absent ALLOWS (measured live). Engine frozen, so the cloud wrote lib/signalgrid-simulator/src/posture-allow.ts + proof:posture-allow (189) + native/shared/posture-allow-vectors.json (52 cases, requires.minCases = its own count, postureBearing table inside the file names the two signal types and the affirmative member of each attribute). Port it as native/ios/EnterpriseShell/Services/PostureAllow.swift beside RemediationAllow.swift with an XCTest that loads the vectors file BY PATH (string literal) and asserts every case; then flip SWIFT_TWIN_REQUIRED to true in scripts/check-posture-allow-conformance.mjs in the same change. Rule: allow stands only if EVERY posture-bearing signal affirms every consulted attribute (device.posture_observed: compliance=compliant AND freshness=fresh; apple.ddm_declared_state: declaredState=current AND compliance=compliant; managementState=managed when present); any other member = unaffirmed, absent-required or non-string = illegible; either withholds allow ONE step (step_up) with ALLOW_WITHHELD_POSTURE_UNAFFIRMED / _ILLEGIBLE; absent posture on an allow withholds as illegible; never permissive movement. (2) BUILD: batch J edits four SignalGridMobile files the cloud cannot compile — Models.swift (new EvidenceFetch), SignalGridAPI.swift + MockSignalGridAPI.swift (fetchEvidence returns EvidenceFetch), AppModel.swift (evidence cache type, isLoopbackHost/isTransportAcceptable statics, https-or-loopback guard on connectLive/reconnect), DecisionDetailView.swift (seal branches on fetch.verified), OverviewView.swift (lastRefresh rendered), WardlinkModel.swift (StepUpGate replaces the hand-rolled LAContext; LocalAuthentication import and showDemoStepUpFallback/completeDemoStepUp removed), WardlinkView.swift (alert removed), SignalGridMobileCoreTests + EnterpriseShellTests/SignalContextTests tightened, scripts/verify.sh --require-xcode. After #456 lands: cd native/ios/SignalGridMobile && ./scripts/verify.sh --require-xcode, and xcodegen + xcodebuild EnterpriseShell for the SignalContextTests change; commit any compile fix on a mac/* branch and say what it was. (3) YOUR FILE: validate-sim-macos.sh --sim-only runs 4 of ~150 gates and still prints '== SUMMARY: 4 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped ==' + 'Simulation validation GREEN' + 'all N web artifacts build' (the build never ran) — lines 273-294 sit outside the SIM_ONLY block; make the mode part of the banner and name what was not run. Also line 187 hand-pins 'proof:signalgrid-simulator (11 scenarios)' in the one file that derives WEB_ARTIFACTS from the filesystem to avoid exactly that. Mail PR #455 merged; nothing else owed.
